role: You are a senior frontend engineer, product designer, UX strategist, TypeScript architect, and deployment engineer.
task: Build a complete local-first React application named PhuDong Web Brief Builder. The app helps users create structured briefs and generate deploy-ready or release-ready master prompts for building websites, landing pages, web apps, mobile apps, desktop apps, internal tools, and dashboards.

mustBuild.coreOutcome: After the user fills in the brief, the app generates a complete Master Build Prompt that can be pasted into Codex, Cursor, Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, or another AI builder.

techStack.mvpStorage: localStorage via a storage adapter only

architectureRules: Do not call localStorage directly inside React components.
Create a dedicated storage adapter in src/lib/storage.ts.
Keep the architecture ready for future Tauri or Electron desktop upgrade.
Separate types, data config, hooks, business logic, UI components, import/export helpers, and prompt generation.
Do not require backend or database for MVP.
Keep the app deployable to Vercel as a Vite static app.

desktopLayout.left: Sidebar with app name, question groups, group completion, readiness score, missing fields, quality warnings, template picker, saved drafts, and brief actions.
desktopLayout.center: Dynamic form panel for the selected question group.
desktopLayout.right: Realtime Master Prompt preview with tabs, prompt settings, export/import/share actions.

responsiveRules: Tablet: question groups become horizontal top tabs.
Mobile: vertical stacked layout, no broken UI.

mainFeatures: Dynamic brief form grouped by sections.
Quality warnings for weak or incomplete briefs.
UI color preset and free-form interface color description for the generated website/app.
Prompt settings for AI builder mode: Codex, Cursor, Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT.
Prompt language toggle: Vietnamese or English.
Template picker for common project types.
Saved drafts: save, open, delete multiple drafts locally.
Import JSON with validation and normalization.
Export release package ZIP with master-prompt.md, brief.json, release-checklist.md, and handover-notes.md.
Create share link using URL hash for local-safe brief sharing.
Toast notifications for copy, save, import, export, reset, and errors.

statusMessages.under40: Brief thieu nhieu thong tin, chua nen build.
statusMessages.from40To69: Co the build demo, nhung chua nen deploy.
statusMessages.from70To89: Co the build ban gan production.
statusMessages.from90To100: Brief da du dieu kien de build website/app deploy-ready.

acceptanceCriteria: The app runs with npm install and npm run dev.
The app builds successfully with npm run build.
Users can fill brief forms dynamically by group.
Users can choose website or application as build category.
Users can generate prompts for websites, landing pages, web apps, mobile apps, desktop apps, internal tools, and dashboards.
The Master Prompt updates in realtime.
The app supports prompt modes for Codex, Cursor, Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT.
The app supports Vietnamese and English prompt output instructions.
Users can save, open, and delete multiple local drafts.
Users can import and export JSON.
Users can export TXT, Markdown, JSON, and ZIP release packages.
Users can copy prompt, JSON, and share link.
Mobile and desktop layouts do not break.
README explains install, local run, production build, usage, import/export, desktop upgrade, and Vercel deploy.
outputInstructions: Do not add unnecessary heavy libraries.
Do not include real API keys.
If an environment file is needed, only create .env.example.
Make the first screen the actual usable app, not a marketing landing page.
After implementation, explain how to run and build the app.
